title: Three Tuesdays and One Short Stand
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：keyboard　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 keyboard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2002 the typist ① cleaned the keyboard that no student in the room would have recorded, and he said the cleaning was the whole of the Tuesday. The ② keyboard, meaning the board itself and not the stand, ran three Tuesdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a keyboard, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ keyboard in that room had the same short stand beside it, and the ④ keyboard at the far desk, meaning the letter they kept for the children to press and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A keyboard, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the typist said the recording is the part that fills three Tuesdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the keyboard was the whole of the matter, meaning the touch and not the board. The ⑥ keyboard, meaning the touch and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; keyboard, he said, is either something you clean or the only word that means both a board and a touch. He said the touch is the part they remember.

By 2007 the ⑦ keyboard had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short stand. The ⑧ keyboard of the whole thing, the typist wrote in June, was one room and three Tuesdays of recording; keyboard, he said, is either the letter at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ keyboard I remember is the board recorded in the log, which closed in 2009 and is still recorded as the quietest in the room. A ⑩ keyboard, my mother said in 2011, is the only board that improves by being recorded; every keyboard, she said, is a touch that has agreed to look like a board. She said the touch was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 键盘；琴键（指机房里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 键盘；琴键（指那个键盘本身，与托架相对）
C. 固定搭配：clean the keyboard 清洁这个键盘
D. n. 键盘；琴键（指留给孩子们按下的一个那一个）
E. n. 输入之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的键盘之事）
F. n. 键盘；琴键（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 触感、手法（指一件事里人人都敲却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手法（抽象总称，指人人都敲却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleaned the keyboard that no student in the room would have recorded

answers.why: clean the keyboard 意为“清洁这个键盘”，2002 年那位打字员把机房里没有一位学生肯记录的一个键盘做了一遍。
keyboard 意为“键盘；琴键”，指那个键盘本身而不是托架，它经过了三个星期二而在簿子上没有被记录。
keyboard 意为“键盘；琴键”，指机房里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一个窄窄的托架。
keyboard 意为“键盘；琴键”，指最远那张书桌留给孩子们按下的一个那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
keyboard 意为“触感、手法”，指一件事里人人都敲却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种触感就是那件事的全部。
keyboard 意为“手法”，指人人都敲却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个键盘，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
keyboard 意为“键盘；琴键”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 2007 年这一个成了记录里的一行。
keyboard 意为“输入之事”，打字员六月写道，整件事的键盘之事是一处机房和三个星期二的记录。
keyboard 意为“键盘；琴键”，我记得的是记录里记录过的那一个，2009 年换好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一个。
keyboard 为抽象总称，母亲 2011 年说，键盘是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的键盘。
